svg.title: Four Core Seats, Two Deliberate Scale Additions
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-four-to-six-person-pod; chart type: org_architecture; title: Four Core Seats, Two Deliberate Scale Additions; subtitle: Base and Conservative use 1 FT + 3 C; Scaled uses 2 FT + 4 C.; chapter number: 11; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: FT means full-time employee; C means contractor seat with explicit scheduled capacity. Numeric values show headcount presence: one for each core seat and zero for each scale-only seat at Base. The last two stages each add one person at Scaled. Client counsel and external advisers are outside this pod.; caption: Base staffing is four people, not four full-time equivalents. Add one employee and one contractor only when sustained queues, service budgets, and signed contracts support them.; stages: label: Operations lead; value: Core full-time seat owns service scope and invoice reconciliation; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own the service ledger, vendor economics, access permissions, and daily exception queue. Escalate legal decisions to client counsel. Use the Base $60,000 loaded labor allowance without counting owner profit as a second operating expense.; label: Intake specialist; value: Core contractor seat verifies provenance and administrative completeness; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Maintain contact evidence, identity discrepancies, and duplicate-retainer flags within the $30,000 Base allowance. Do not provide legal advice or independently decide whether the law firm should represent a claimant.; label: Record retrieval coordinator; value: Core contractor seat manages authorizations and provider follow-up; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Use the $30,000 Base allowance to manage request receipts, scope defects, delivery channels, and provider invoices. Maintain route-specific timers; never assume every provider request shares the individual-access deadline.; label: Chronology quality specialist; value: Core contractor seat validates extracted facts against source pages; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Use the $24,000 Base allowance for chronology verification and structured deficiency tickets. Restrict LLM access to approved environments; if clinical interpretation is required, assign appropriately qualified personnel.; label: Delivery manager; value: Scaled addition creates the second full-time employee seat; numeric value: 0.0; detail: Add when sustained record and invoice queues exceed the measured capacity of the four-person pod. Separate daily workload assignment from the lead's contract ownership, and budget within the Scaled $625,000 total expense envelope.; label: Evidence exception specialist; value: Scaled addition creates the fourth contractor seat; numeric value: 0.0; detail: Add targeted capacity for complex pharmacy histories, missing implant records, and replacement-window rework. The resulting six-person pod is 2 FT + 4 C; do not carry Base labor allocations forward unchanged.
